essence: Undesignated reality: spoken only by self-feeling's true method.
Teaching without inner trust: no final fruit.
Means: wakefulness in self-awakening; sage stands undivided.
No means but following own being; follower abides, happy.
Concept-grasping, pure knowing, supreme joy: one-mass awakening.
Concepts restrained: power rests in powerful; oneness the goal.
Form known, sheath cast, striving scattered: called freed.
Fully-awake mind grasps awakening alone till grounded-alone.

rasa.justification: The prescriptions demand heroic holding — wakefulness kept, concepts gripped still, grasp held alone — yet every verb stills: restrained, cast off, scattered. Resolve serves quiescence, never agitates it.

sections.BOUNDARY: No fruit is described; the fruit's first-person seal belongs to the standing that follows.
sections.EXPLANATION: Question and answer: how speak the undescribed (by self-feeling's method); what without trust (no fruit). Thesis: wakefulness in self-awakening (ms. locative kept), no means but following own being. Ladder: concepts grasped, knowing purified, joy won — one-mass awakening; concepts restrained — power in powerful; form known, sheath cast, striving scattered — freed; grasp held on awakening alone till grounded-alone from own capacity.
sections.FUNCTION: Answers the opening question with the single method, then walks its stages to the freed name.
sections.KEY TERMS: svasaṃvedana-sadyukti (self-feeling's true method) — the only access; āśvāsa (trust) — without it, no fruit; jāgarūkatā (wakefulness) — the method; svasattānugama (following own being) — the sole exception; bodhaikaghanatā (one-mass awakening) — the ripening; śakti/śaktimat (power/powerful) — oneness the goal; bodhamātra (awakening alone) — the axis guarded.
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: The method pledged here pays out across the fruit: wakefulness-words return in every later standing.
sections.RELATED: Hanneder ms. readings kept (svabodhe, sukhī, kīrṇe, mātre); Sanderson's nine stanzas edited earlier; bodha-vs-jñāna axis guarded throughout.
sections.SUMMARY: Speaking needs self-feeling's method; trustless teaching bears nothing. One means: wakefulness in self-awakening, following own being and nothing else. Concepts grasped, knowing purified, joy won — awakening masses whole; power rests in the powerful. Form known, sheath dropped, striving scattered: freed. Hold waking alone till grounded-alone.
